metric_note: registered metrics are diagnostics, not automatically proved mathematical metrics

transform_family_notes.facet_permutation: uniform shuffle of the facet row list
transform_family_notes.sampled_block_symplectic: block subgroup diag(A,A^{-T}); useful subgroup test, not full Sp(4)
transform_family_notes.sampled_full_group: composition of scale, translation, facet permutation, and sampled_sp4_exp
transform_family_notes.sampled_sp4_exp: full-dimensional local Sp(4) exponential sample exp(JH), H symmetric; not Haar-like
transform_family_notes.scale: positive scalar sampled from an exponential range
transform_family_notes.scale_translation_permutation: composition of scale, translation, and facet permutation
transform_family_notes.translation: interior translation direction with bounded radius
